## Phase 2 — BLOCKED (2026-10-06)

Refs #265. Canonical Owner **A**; **B** implementation / QA. Original implementation branch and Draft PR retained; no merge, auto-merge, issue closure or downstream work.

The current Node set now uses a thin unified entry with read-only inventory checking, existing TASK086 lane adaptation, event/receipt verification and controlled CI. Latest develop4888b4d and task997ce9e were normally merged. Final delivery head: `a77ec0ae24a555aba09ed6c6fc6520d2a5e2442c`.

**Required validation is blocked:** the frozen TASK086 certification binds complete package.json and quality-gate.yml bytes. The authorized script/workflow changes invalidate its eligibility/closeout hashes, causing three mandatory assertions to fail. Only those two changed bound files explain the difference; no protected evidence, data or business rules were rewritten. Owner decision/authorization is needed in the certification scope before this phase can pass.

- Verified exact-develop baseline: [run37422119153](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37422119153), 3,887 tests, full original proof chain; downloaded logs and516 input bindings checked.
- Candidate72fe79f29: 3,898 executed tests across five lanes, 3,895 passed /3 failed; rebuild and full proof did not complete. Remaining costly graph work was cancelled after the blocker, never marked PASS.
- Governance12/12 and compatibility23/23; candidate lint/types/scoped-format/build/artifact gates PASS. Final-head evidence is recorded in the delivery comments after its checks finish.
- Windows Asset30s timeout reproduced on clean develop as well (164/165 both); hosted Linux Asset lanes passed. No timeout/assertion relaxation.
- DB/browser/real-device/bundle/live Provider/cloud tests NOT_RUN. No production Provider call or db:reset.

[Phase2 Result](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/a77ec0ae24a555aba09ed6c6fc6520d2a5e2442c/docs/tasks/RESULT-TASK-035-b-wbs-9-1-phase2-baseline-integration.md) · [QA](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/tree/a77ec0ae24a555aba09ed6c6fc6520d2a5e2442c/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-2) · [binding blocker](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/a77ec0ae24a555aba09ed6c6fc6520d2a5e2442c/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-2/binding-blocker.json)

Final [branch exact-head run37467190704](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37467190704) and [PR merge-ref run37467203410](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37467203410) are separate; neither is claimed green here. WBS9.1 stays **blocked**, not completed or ready for review.

## Historical original PR evidence — 2026-09-10 / f157f23ba

The following original summary is preserved as history, not current acceptance or a failure exemption.

## Summary
- establish the canonical Node test entry and CI mapping
- document all Node, contract, DB/Auth runtime, browser and external test layers
- add a local-only Edge smoke without a second project test framework
- keep two existing Asset catalog failures visible

## Validation
- TASK-035 governance: 3/3 PASS
- routing: 28/28 PASS
- DB static: 13/13 PASS
- Local Profile: 25/25 PASS
- Local Auth: 16/16 PASS
- Edge browser smoke: 8/8 PASS
- lint / typecheck / build / deploy artifact: PASS
- canonical Node baseline: 711/713 PASS; 2 existing Asset catalog failures documented

Refs #265

## TASK-035-A / WBS 9.1 — B-supported Phase 1 audit scope published (2026-10-06)

Refs #265. The user agreed to split this work: first audit and Test Inventory only; runner/CI implementation requires a subsequent review and authorization. Canonical Owner remains **A**; **B** is the execution support for this audit.

Published amendment:
[AMENDMENT-TASK-035-b-wbs-9-1-phase1-audit-only.md](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/4fbbe4a12626b41ddcad15cc9ebf9440698192fc/docs/tasks/AMENDMENT-TASK-035-b-wbs-9-1-phase1-audit-only.md)

- Checked original PR head: `f157f23ba1b93def006c2703ea8f42dcd9266c01`

The audit must compare this existing implementation with current develop and classify deliverables as REUSE / REWORK / SUPERSEDED / DEFER, rather than start a second implementation. It must inventory current test files, helpers, harnesses and CI event/condition coverage. No CI, package/lockfile, existing runner/tests, application, DB or POI/Transport data changes are authorized in Phase 1. Full regression, graph rebuild, DB/browser runtime and live Provider execution are not required for the static audit and must not be claimed as PASS when not executed.

This update publishes the task definition only: no audit execution or WBS completion is claimed. No new implementation Issue/PR was created; the original implementation branch and PR state are unchanged. No merge, auto-merge, Issue closure, or Phase 2 start is authorized. Audit outputs will be published separately on the documentation branch and stop for manual review.

## TASK-035-A / WBS 9.1 — B Phase 1 audit publication receipt (2026-10-06 JST)

- Normal push succeeded; `git ls-remote` confirmed the audit branch equals this commit. develop and original implementation/PR head remain unchanged. Dedicated audit worktree is clean; the dirty primary worktree was preserved.

Static CI selection is 152 direct Node files plus 1 indirect Node and 3 indirect Python files = 156 unique test files; 27 test files have no proven CI selection. The six primary lanes are 5 / 37 / 37 / 36 / 36 / 1, with disjoint union equal to the 152-file selector. Suites/cases executed remain null.

Unresolved dimensions are explicit: 487 candidates need at least one ownership/layer/prerequisite review, 200 owners are not uniquely supported, and 15 text references need contextual review (including embedded/generated source and deliberate absence assertions). No unknown was silently made false. All nine old PR changed files were reviewed: 6 REWORK, 2 DEFER, 1 historical REUSE_AS_IS; the typecheck subchange is SUPERSEDED by current develop.

Validation separation:

- **auditValidation: PASS** — two complete fixed-Git scans produce byte-identical JSON; unique IDs/paths, counts, resolved references and shard union verified; 10 in-memory generator self-checks. [Receipt](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/dbf8875250bb22ec8f9d647c84bf7e438aee12d7/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-1/audit-validation.json).
- **businessTestsExecution: NOT_EXECUTED** — no repository Node/Python regression, graph rebuild/extraction/resume/proof, browser/device, DB/Auth, real Provider, lint/typecheck/build/deploy execution. No target runner/import, dependency installation, POI production or db:reset.
- **ciStatus: no run observed for this audit publication**; no manual dispatch. Earlier develop push [run 37422119153](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37422119153) was observed as success through the API only; its actual checkout/proof receipt was not independently verified here and is not Phase 1 execution. PR merge-ref evidence must not be called branch exact-head evidence.

**Protected-file changes: 0.** The commit changes only 13 allowed QA/Task/Result/WBS documents. WBS validation confirms only its 9.1 section/row changed. [Scope receipt](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/dbf8875250bb22ec8f9d647c84bf7e438aee12d7/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-1/scope-validation.json). CI/package/lockfiles, existing runners/tests, business code, migrations and POI/Transport/Asset data were untouched.

Post-push observation: #265 remains OPEN; #272 remains OPEN / Draft / unmerged at the same head; no audit PR exists. This external receipt confirms the amendment checklist's final two publication/stop items, intentionally left unchecked in the pre-publication commit to avoid a self-referential SHA cycle. **Execution has stopped for human review; Phase 2 has not started.**

PR head 为上述最终提交，base 为 `4888b4d507ee75d4f6b9914eb1a8d5661813f64b`。两次运行的日志、事件与回执哈希、run/attempt、输入/清单哈希及选择集合已下载核验；每次五个分片实际153个直接文件，rebuild另1个未完成，不能把3,898写成全仓全部通过。Linux Node v24.21.0、Python 3.12.14；最终已完成的 Asset、regression-0/2、retained extraction、quality（lint/types/scoped format/local build/artifact/diff）通过。
